summary: Iteration 6 (v1.6) — Region naming + multi-lang invoice PDF + Docker Compose deploy artifacts fully verified. Backend pytest: 17/17 PASSED. Frontend UI live-verified on preview URL: cluster widget shows 'Primary EU-West' and 'Secondary EU-Central' cards with 'Sağlıklı (2/2)' badge + 'Cache aktif' Redis label, zero URL/port leakage. Reseller dashboard shows PDF DILI selector (5 langs: Türkçe/English/Deutsch/Français/Español) in 'Fatura Geçmişi' card right header — successfully downloaded EN, DE, FR PDFs with correct filename pattern INV-YYYYMM-XXXXX-<lang>.pdf and toast confirmations. /api/license-server/verify returns 'served_by' as region label with 'replica_id' stripped. Fallback ?lang=jp returns EN body with -jp.pdf filename. Deploy files (docker-compose.yml, haproxy.cfg, README.md) present and content-valid.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/license_client.py `upstream_verify`: `served_by` derivation uses `str(r.request.url).split('/v1/')[0]` which is brittle if path changes. Consider tracking the chosen URL explicitly in `_try_all` return value (return (url, response)).

routes/license_client.py opens fresh `httpx.AsyncClient(...)` per health-check iteration (double `async with` around cluster/health call) — reuse a module-level client via FastAPI lifespan for performance under load.
routes/invoices.py: PDF builder still inline (~180 lines in one function) — split into `pdf_builder.py` for maintainability. i18n dict also grows linearly with languages; extract to JSON/YAML asset.

backend/.env `LICENSE_SERVER_REGIONS` count must match `PUBLIC_LICENSE_SERVER_URL` count. If ops mistakenly adds a third URL without a third label, code pads with 'Region-N' — good defensive default, but log a warning.

deploy/docker-compose.yml — verify with `docker compose config` was not executed here (docker not installed in the sandbox). Recommend adding a CI step or a syntax lint (yamllint) in the deploy README.
Frontend Reseller.js does not disable the PDF button while a download is in flight — rapid double-click can trigger duplicate downloads. Minor UX.
pypdf added as dev/test dep — add to /app/backend/requirements-dev.txt (or test extras) so future pytest runs don't fail on fresh envs.
